events.title: Final Pre-Launch Update and Fall in Love Visual Novel Festival
events.summary: Hey there gamers, Jacob here. It's been a very busy year, but Siren's Call: Second Wind is done! The bugs are fixed, the game is polished, and we're all set for the November 2nd release date for Steam. Now we wait. And the waiting is the hardest part. If only there was some awesome sort of event to keep us occupied until the big day.... Oh yeah. That's right. Our friends at Studio Élan are having a party of such. A visual novel party. And we're a part of it. To celebrate, we've updated our demo

events.title: Kickstarter for Siren's Call: Second Wind is now live!
events.summary: Happy Valentine's Day, everyone! Get ready for the wedding of a lifetime! Our Kickstarter for Siren's Call: Second Wind is now live!The launch for our Kickstarter is now live! Our previous game, Siren's Call: Escape Velocity also was launched on Kickstarter and reached its funding goal. We also have a demo out if you want to give it a spin. Please check the link down below if you're interested! If you have any questions, don't be afraid to ask!https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1943441370/sire

events.title: The Siren's Call: Second Wind Kickstarter is here!
events.summary: It's time. Hey everybody, Jacob here. I hope you enjoyed the demo for Second Wind. Wanna see more? Wanna help make the game real? Now is your chance! Go sign up for the Siren’s Call: Second Wind Kickstarter. Otherwise Ruth will start living in your walls. If we pass our first stretch goal goal, I'll make it so people can vote on what kind of content they want to see in the game. Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1943441370/sirens-call-second-wind-love-is-in-the-air We'll see you
